items.title: Pay settling-in package invoice
items.quote: Please pay within 30 days of the date of this letter by bank transfer to the account shown below, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: Letter dated 11 February 2026 (Wednesday). This is a private-law payment obligation (civil contract, not an authority letter), so the period starts the day after the letter's date per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB: counting begins 12 February 2026. Adding 30 days per § 188 Abs. 1 BGB lands on Friday, 13 March 2026. That day is a working day (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW), so § 193 BGB requires no shift. Due date: 13 March 2026. (To be safe, send the transfer by 12 March 2026 to allow one business day for it to arrive per § 675s BGB.)

warnings: The IBAN printed (DE41 3705 0198 0009 0199 01) is a valid, well-formed German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not confirm it belongs to the stated company — verify it against a previous invoice or the company's official website before paying.
